    The line step from long lines #

    LinesOfEveryLength is the large-line input of the representation-finite case (BO23, proof of Theorem 7, lines 876–882; BO13b, Theorem ssc): when every finite convex piece of the universal cover is representation-finite and graded indecomposables have unbounded supports, the cover contains lines of every length. The line lemma (BO13b, Lemma 7.2) then gives the line step: lines of every length exclude contours (noContour_of_lines), so k(P) is a zero-relation algebra, and a minimal good pair of sinks of a long line gives a monomial band (nonempty_monomialBand).
